stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Beauty matters in public spaces, but during shortage, priorities change.”?
options: Sometimes a mistake can become an idea if people are willing to look at it differently.
A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.
Working with nature can sometimes protect people better than forcing nature into straight lines.
A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.
